message.content:
Crypto basics can feel simple once you separate the coins from the tools that help you use them.

## Wallets and payments
A popular myth says that a crypto wallet app stores your coins inside the app. [#25]
In reality, it helps you manage the keys that let you access coins recorded on a blockchain.
Some say that a crypto payment sent to the wrong address can usually be undone. [#26]
